calibration_sources: Consistent Hashing with Bounded Load for Stateful LLM KV-Prefix Geo-Routing
Metro Multi-AZ RoCEv2 Distributed KV Cache vs Cross-Region Token-Transcript Replication
Hybrid On-Premises Base (P60) + Cloud GPU Bursting (P95) Capacity Amortization Model

tiers.name: Tier 1: Single-Region Active + Passive Cold-Standby DR Region (Scale-from-Zero on Outage)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 1: 单地域主备冷灾备 (Active-Passive，故障时冷拉备份地域 GPU 集群)
tiers.routing_and_state_sync: 100% traffic in Primary Region; Secondary Region unprovisioned / cold until DNS failover

tiers.name: Tier 2: Stateless Geo-Round-Robin Active-Active (2 Regions at 200% Static Peak Capacity, No Session Affinity)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 2: 跨地域无状态轮询双活 (Stateless Geo-Round-Robin，打碎多轮 KV 缓存 + 200% 静态冗余)
tiers.routing_and_state_sync: Anycast / Round-Robin across Region A & Region B (65ms WAN RTT); Turn N+1 lands on random region

tiers.name: Tier 3: Metro Multi-AZ Active-Active (3 AZs <1.5ms Dark Fiber + Shared L2 Distributed KV Cache Pool)
tiers.name_zh: Tier 3: 同城三可用区双活 (Multi-AZ <1.5ms 裸光纤 + 跨 AZ 分布式 L2 KV 缓存池)
tiers.routing_and_state_sync: Consistent-Hash Session Routing + Cross-AZ Compressed KV Block Replication over 1.2ms Metro RoCE

tiers.name: Tier 4: Session-Sticky Geo-Active-Active (Bounded-Load Hash) + Async Token-Transcript Replay + Hybrid Cloud Bursting
tiers.name_zh: Tier 4: 跨地域会话粘性双活 (有界负载一致性哈希) + 异步文本流复制重放 + 混合云弹性溢出
tiers.routing_and_state_sync: Session-Sticky Geo-Router + 40KB Compressed Token-IDs Replication (Not 8GB Raw KV!) + P60 Base + Cloud Spot Burst

wan_replication_comparison.replication_payload_mode: Raw GQA-8 KV Cache Tensor (32K Context = 8.0 GB per Session)
wan_replication_comparison.verdict: Physically Impossible over WAN! Saturates 100Gbps inter-region links at just 15 sessions/s ✕

wan_replication_comparison.replication_payload_mode: DeepSeek MLA Latent FP8 KV Cache (32K Context = 0.70 GB per Session)
wan_replication_comparison.verdict: Feasible inside Metro Multi-AZ (<1.5ms 400G RoCE), still too heavy for cross-continent WAN ⚠️

wan_replication_comparison.replication_payload_mode: Token-ID Transcript + Tool State JSON (32K Context = 64 KB compressed)
wan_replication_comparison.verdict: 128,000x Smaller! Replicates across continents in <1ms; peer region recomputes KV only on actual failover 🏆
